name: Azure WebApp
description: Deploy Web Apps/Containerized Web Apps to Azure. github.com/Azure/Actions

app-name.description: Name of the Azure Web App

publish-profile.description: Applies to Web Apps(Windows and Linux) and Web App Containers(linux). Multi container scenario not supported. Publish profile (*.publishsettings) file contents

slot-name.description: Enter an existing Slot other than the Production slot

package.description: Applies to Web App only: Path to package or folder. *.zip, *.war, *.jar or a folder to deploy

images.description: Applies to Web App Containers only: Specify the fully qualified container image(s) name. For example, 'myregistry.azurecr.io/nginx:latest' or 'python:3.7.2-alpi

configuration-file.description: Applies to Web App Containers only: Path of the Docker-Compose file. Should be a fully qualified path or relative to the default working directory. Required for

startup-command.description: Enter the start up command. For ex. dotnet run or dotnet run

resource-group-name.description: Enter the resource group name of the web app

type.description: Enter deployment type (JAR, WAR, EAR, ZIP, Static)

target-path.description: Target path in the web app. For ex. '/home/site/wwwroot'

clean.description: Delete existing files target directory before deploying

restart.description: Restart the app service after deployment

sitecontainers-config.description: Applies to Sitecontainers, containes a list of siteContainer specs
